Distributed Control System

VAX 
 Highway Interface (VXI)
Westinghouse Company
رقم الوثيقة: DCS-018-r0

صدرت إلى: 
 دمياط CCPS
حالة: موافقة
مقدمة

This document outlines the equipment inspection 
I1, to be performed on an annually bases as indicated by Y1 in the title block.

The function of the VXI is to get and print the data of any unit operation 
within a certain time to serve fault analysis for example.

The VAX highway 
interface (VXI) Consists of:

MSP card, controller card, 
part # (772B388G59) .

MUA card, interface card, 
part # (7381A06G01).

MHC card, data highway 
controller card, part # (7381A93G01)

MMI power supply,input:220VAC, 
output :+12VDC، + 5VDC)، الجزء # (4D33613G02).

2 Cooling fan, 230VAC, 14 
watt, part # (2450D25G03) .

المسودة الأولى بدأها المهندس. محمد أبو الخير في 03 مارس 2005، 
تم اختباره بواسطة المهندس. محمد يونس في 09 مارس 2005، تمت مراجعته بواسطة مراقبة الجودة م. عبد 
منعم الإمام في EDEPC تم قبوله من قبل المدير العام م. عادل الكيلاني، و 
وافق عليها المهندس . محمد حمودة السراج رئيس قطاع مركز شرطة دمياط.

This document 
accepted by
eng. Samir Abdel Gilil; EDEPC MPIS coordinator, and certified by 
accountant Mahmoud Mohamed Soliman; general director of Admin.& Financial 
quality control, and supervisor of EDEPC inspection & quality control Head 
sector.
احتياطات السلامة

A work permit must be issued 
and the qualified maintenance staff should carry the suitable safety category

Personal 
pratective equipment must be used ground strap 
...etc.

The online maintenance work on 
the VXI cabinet must not affect the operation status of the plant.

Make backup for software 
before work if it is required.

Disconnect the cabinet from 
data highway if required according to station status without any effect on 
operation of plant.

sections.text: العمل المراد تنفيذه

Check the operation of network card function 
 [data highway controller card (MHC)] using system highway errors diagram.
Clean all cabinet card from dust by blower.

التحقق من حالة الخزانة باستخدام (system 
 عرض الحالة) الرسم البياني.

تحقق من حالة مصدر الطاقة عن طريق 
المصابيح 
 on front of power supply:

If three LEDS for output voltage 
 (-12,+12,+5VDC) 
 تشغيل يعني أن مصدر الطاقة على ما يرام.
If any LED of three output voltage LEDS OFF that is means the power supply failed and must be replaced

Check the operation of cabinet cooling fan 
 for noise and temperature.
